_llm_instructions: Populate the fields of 'Team Onboarding Checklist' and write the value of each field under 'Generated Value', based on the project context. Context: the project carrying reference PMO-05.12.

f01_Task.label: Task
f01_Task.guidance: The activity, written so that a person who does not know the project can tell whether it is done. "Get set up" is not a task; "reviewed the onboarding document" is.

f02_Assigned_To.label: Assigned To
f02_Assigned_To.guidance: Who does it, which is not the same as who is waiting for it. Most onboarding tasks are somebody's one-off action, and naming the one-off is what stops the new member chasing something nobody owns.

f03_Due_Date.label: Due Date
f03_Due_Date.guidance: When it should be complete, relative to the joining date rather than to a calendar day, because the joining date moves and a checklist full of fixed dates has to be redone when it does.

f04_Status.label: Status
f04_Status.guidance: Done or pending, and the date it was done. A checklist nobody updates is one that has quietly stopped being true, and the entry is what shows it has.
